title: Duplicates without nested loops
prompt: `hasDuplicates` compares every pair, which is slow for big lists. Rewrite it with a single pass (no nested loops); the tests must still pass.

banned.message: No indexOf/includes: they hide a second loop
No indexOf/includes: they hide a second loop
No .count(): it hides a second loop

hints: A set remembers what you have seen in constant time.
